messages:
Alex (AE): FYI — CobaltInsure POC needs SOC2 artifacts + signed pen-test letter before procurement signs. Also asking for Dedicated pricing for 4x A100 for 3 months. Customer deadline EOW.

Jamal (SE): Got it. Do they need full SOC2 report or just control matrix/attestation? Also what's target latency/throughput for the POC?

Alex (AE): They asked for the full SOC2 Type II report and a pen-test attestation. Latency requirement is <200ms p95, about 50 concurrent users. POC starts in two weeks.

Maria (InfoSec): We don't share full SOC2 report externally — we provide an executive summary + SOC2 bridge letter + control matrix. For customers requiring full report we do an NDA + limited distribution. I'll confirm timeline.

Alex (AE): Ok can you confirm NDA route? Legal is pushing for standard SOW timeline.

Nisha (SalesOps): For Dedicated pricing — provisional quote: $48k/month for 4 reserved A100s (on-demand equivalent). For a 3-month POC we can offer a 15% trial discount; need finance approval. I'll link the quote.

Nisha (SalesOps): Quote link: https://redwood.example.com/quotes/COBALT-POC-001 (internal)

Jamal (SE): On the security side — can we provide a pen-test letter template? Customer needs vendor-signed letter that says we had a pen test and no critical findings. LegalBot, do we have a standard pen-test attestation doc?

LegalBot: Pen-test attestation template available: https://redwood.example.com/legal/attestations/pen-test-template.docx. We can sign PDF after Legal reviews. For third-party pentest letters, we require the pentest vendor's scope + date.

Maria (InfoSec): Action items — (1) I can prepare Exec SOC2 summary + control matrix by Thu EOD. (2) I need the NDA signed to share the full report if they insist. (3) I'll draft the pen-test attestation for Legal to sign. @Nisha can you confirm finance ok with 15% trial discount?

Nisha (SalesOps): I'll ping finance now. If they approve, I'll produce amended quote and a short PO template. ETA 24h.

Alex (AE): Customer also asked about data residency — they want EU hosting. Is that supported on Dedicated POC?

Jamal (SE): Yes we can provision in eu-west1 for Dedicated. Lead time ~5 business days for reserved infra. For POC we can spin up a temporary Dedicated in EU with temporary tokens.

Alex (AE): Perfect. Customer asked for a sample pen-test attestation wording — I pasted a short draft below. Maria/Legal, please tweak and sign if okay:

```text
Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was conducted on 2025-01-15 covering the production tenant and infrastructure. No critical vulnerabilities affecting confidentiality or integrity were identified. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and is not a substitute for the full report.
```

Maria (InfoSec): That wording is fine but change 'production tenant' -> 'production infrastructure and control plane'. Also remove the specific date unless we confirm. I'll update and attach.

LegalBot: We'll need the pentest vendor name + scope to include in the signed attestation. Also add standard limit: 'provided for informational purposes and subject to confidentiality obligations.'

Alex (AE): I'll ask the customer to confirm vendor/scope and whether NDA is acceptable for full report. Thanks everyone — please add any docs to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/sales/cobalt-poc

Maria (InfoSec): Uploaded Exec summary + control matrix draft to the drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/sales/cobalt-poc/soc2-summary.pdf :white_check_mark:

Jamal (SE): I'll prepare a short runbook for EU Dedicated POC (provision steps + expected metrics) and drop in drive.

Alex (AE): Awesome. I'll update the customer and loop back after finance/legal confirm. :thumbsup:
